## Change
Describe the change and identify its claim, file, or release gate.

## Evidence
Give exact commands, versions, inputs, exit status, and result. Distinguish artifact
checks, finite experiments, and actual Lean compilation. A missing tool or timeout
is not a passing check.

## Review
- [ ] The frozen Block 34 mathematical source is unchanged, or this is an explicitly reviewed correction.
- [ ] The change does not add an unproved public claim or imply that a Python test is a proof.
- [ ] No private development history, personal metadata, secrets, or dependency binaries are included.
- [ ] The export file hashes and relevant tests were updated deliberately.
- [ ] Rights and attribution remain unchanged unless the owner explicitly approved a change.
